Definition: of Hebrew origin (H3389); Hierusalem (i.e. Jerushalem), the capitol of Palestine:--Jerusalem. Compare G2414.
BiblicalUsage: Jerusalem is the capital of Palestine, named 76 times in Scripture, in Acts, Galatians, and 1 Corinthians. The full story of the place lives in the Bible itself, and this study covers only the name’s use.
TheologicalSignificance: I take Jerusalem seriously as a real place in God’s story, not a made-up one. That is why its name belongs in this study, even when the Bible says little about it.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
